requirement: Inbox: the left column shows an Inbox row with the server's unread count, and pressing it opens the tracy:inbox tab with Unread selected

oracle.invariant: The build check prints a count >= 1. U is an integer >= 0 and NOAUTH === '401'. The unit seam exits 0 with '# fail 0'. NAV_AFTER_NEW === true. WIDE_BADGE (and RAIL_BADGE when the rail was seen) is null when U === 0, String(U) when 1 <= U <= 9, and '9+' when U > 9. At least one logged GET /api/notifications/unread happened after page load, and one GET /api/notifications?filter=unread after the click. PRESSED starts with 'Unread' (followed by U when U > 0); MARK_DISABLED === (U === 0). When U === 0, ROWS === 0 and the tab shows 'You’re all caught up'.
